status: User accepted 2 exact diagnostic sites on 2026-10-07. Focused qualification and its limits are unchanged; full RPM/native ARM gates remain open.

source_review.lookaround: CompileLookaround emits START, body, WRITE and END in order. Nested lookarounds are queued for later compilation, rather than interleaved. START initializes both the optional Lookaround and its index before WRITE consumes them. The diagnostic reproduces when release-mode DCHECKs are disabled; debug-mode checks let this smaller control prove the invariant.
source_review.deoptimization: The first scan either returns or stops on a JumpLoop whose interval contains the deopt offset. The second scan starts at that same instruction: its target cannot exceed the offset, so it initializes last_deopt_in_range_loop_jump_target before any subsequent break. Reaching the end returns before the third scan consumes that value.

coverage.lookaround_matrix: Every permutation of zero through four lookaround IDs; all ahead/behind and captured/noncaptured masks; dense and gapped IDs; registers inside/outside lookarounds; first filter and maximum quantifier ID; minimal empty table. 131310 cases per normal/memory release/debug run.
coverage.deoptimization_matrix: Six empty, single, sequential, nested and removed-outer-loop layouts; every optimization-slot mask, every offset in a 32-instruction program, IC enabled/disabled. 288000 cases per normal/memory release/debug run. Check exact policy-table selection, no duplicate deopts, preservation of other cache entries and balanced no-GC scope.
coverage.memory: All four qualified Valgrind runs have zero errors and all allocations freed.
coverage.actual_regexp: Experimental linear engine agrees with normal Node regexp results, captures and indices for fifteen patterns over all strings of length zero through five from a/b/c, including nested lookarounds. Invalid syntax and empty lookahead covered.
coverage.actual_optimized_loops: TurboFan optimization is verified before double/object/throwing conversions in nested loops. Results match an independent coefficient convolution; exception identity, conversion counts and recovery are checked.

control_corrections: The first lookaround control inadvertently retained DCHECKs in both modes. Final release/debug variants use the upstream assertion policy; the release warning reproduces.
An empty no-GC adapter produced an unrelated unused-variable warning. The final adapter has balanced RAII state, checked after every case.

The first deoptimization reference required all cached loops in the same outer group to be evicted. The original scan deliberately stops at a later sibling loop; the final independently declared interval table records that boundary. No runtime change or weaker memory check was made.

upstream_context.relevance: Later upstream policy explicitly permits retaining cached OSR code outside the loop containing the exit. This is context for avoiding an overstrict eviction reference, not a backport or proof that the two implementations have identical selection policies.

limits: The scan bodies and opcode enum are verbatim; typed bytecode, iterator, heap and feedback adapters replace the full V8 VM. Iterator offsets are normalized to fixed-size control instructions.
The deoptimization control verifies the current implementation’s selected-cache policy and initialization safety; it does not claim optimal cache eviction or benchmark its performance.
Actual JavaScript tests establish result/exception behavior but do not claim every native adapter path executes in that binary.
No runtime patch, suppression or compiler-flag change is proposed.
